editorial:
Imagine trying to get a full night of sleep while everything around you is designed to keep you awake. That is exactly what you get with this classic short. You follow a grumpy dad bear who just wants to hibernate in peace, but his family won't let it happen. Between his son's loud snoring and his wife constantly messing with the window, it is a total nightmare for the poor guy. The vibe is super relatable because we have all dealt with noisy roommates or family members when we are just trying to nap. It is a simple story, but it hits home in a funny way.

What really makes this work is the timing and the funny facial expressions. The pacing starts slow and builds up into a frantic mess that will have you laughing out loud. While it is an older cartoon, the jokes still land today. It is a perfect pick for a quick laugh with the kids.
endingExplained: After fighting every single noise in the cave, Pa Bear finally thinks he has won. He gets everything quiet and just as he is about to fall asleep, the voices of spring arrive. The loud sounds of nature wake him up one last time. He completely snaps and loses his cool, realizing he will never get his nap. He ends up waking up fully, defeated by the change of seasons.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic cartoons and slapstick humor.
